subject: spt-dy
title: SPT.DY.------PART.
description: Chart 3 of 3 on book p. 439 (TRF(CW)-11). SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) is the subject; PART (participation) is the partner. From the subject: RT-DY (reality dynamics), MOT-DY and TRS (transition). From RT-DY: BIA (bi-aitional). From MOT-DY: C-CONT (composite continuance). From C-CONT: C-RN. From TRS: AF-POST (affinity postulation). From AF-POST: DEF (definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", and AFI (affinity insight).
